phrases.latin: Hīc sumus, Lisbōnae, in extrēmā paenīnsulā; hīc domus nostra, prope Serdicam, in aliā paenīnsulā.
phrases.english: Here we are, in Lisbon, at the far end of a peninsula; here is our home, near Sofia, on another peninsula.
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 205, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
